== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Vehicle Mine (Dark): the entry “Vehicle Mine (Dark)” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 136. Image for [[Vehicle Mine (Dark) (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 136 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.

SHA-1 <code>603326e6aa8d3a29adf4f8f6493cc08a3cc78022</code>, SHA-256 <code>9fb2575b9e36df00dc848528bc917b1177de236540ffbd08d56912c061adf28f</code>.
